qt: to the Commission Daniel Buda (PPE) Subject:

The EU is heavily reliant on imports of protein for animal feed, in particular soya. The Commission has estimated that out of 36 million tonnes of soya imported annually, around 30 million tonnes (85 %), were from genetically modified (GMO) crops, but these figures are based on data from 2016. What is more, the European framework for the cultivation of genetically modified organisms is very restrictive, while imports of these types of agricultural products continue to be authorised , without any adverse consequences having been recorded. 1.

For each of the past five years for which information is available, what is the total amount of feed and feed materials that has come from genetically modified crops imported into the European Union, expressed in tonnes, and the total financial value of these imports, expressed in euro?
Regarding these imports, what were the annual quantities and values of soybean, soybean meal and other products derived from genetically modified soybean?
